title: The Shepherd Knows His Sheep
story:
A shepherd owned many sheep that grazed together in a wide valley.

To most people, the sheep looked exactly the same.

But the shepherd knew each one.

He knew which sheep was timid.

Which one loved to wander.

Which one needed extra care.

Every evening, he stood at the entrance of the sheepfold and called them.

One by one, they recognized his voice.

They left the field and came safely home.

A visitor watched in amazement and asked,

“How do they know which voice to follow?”

The shepherd smiled.

“Because they know they belong to me, and I know each one of them.”

In life, we sometimes feel like just another face in the crowd.

But God never sees us that way.

He made us.

We belong to Him.

He knows us by name.

And like a loving Shepherd, He faithfully leads us every day.
life_lesson: You are not forgotten or insignificant. You belong to God, and He lovingly knows and cares for you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me and calling me Your own.

Thank You that I belong to You and that You know every detail of my life.

Help me to recognize Your voice and follow where You lead.

Keep me close to You each day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you live each day remembering that you belong to God?

Are you listening for His voice above all the other voices around you?

How can you follow your Shepherd more closely today?
